title: God Mace (fire)
description: Adds a God Mace to the game,that lets you shoot fire beams burning any mobs,players in the way.  or shoot a beam on the ground to create Fire
body:
God Mace is a Mace whitch focuses on improving many importent aspects of Mace but also adds abillitys to it. by improving your power. its way better than a normal and deals alot of damage

It also makes you better at PVP, by dealing lots of damage and burning the enemys, how many Totems you have doesnt matter anymore, take on enemy after enemy, by reducing the sight of enemys its annoying like the fire on youre screen.

In the End. It is a Modpack, which holds power
